description:
I used to think Litecoin (LTC) was just a Bitcoin copy… until I did a full deep dive into the tech, the history, and the weird surprises (yes, including a Harry Potter-inspired privacy upgrade). In this video, I break down what Litecoin is, how it compares to Bitcoin vs Litecoin, why it was created by Charlie Lee, and whether LTC is actually still relevant in 2024 going into 2025.

You’ll learn how Litecoin works as a Layer 1 proof-of-work blockchain, why it has 2.5 minute block times, how Scrypt mining differs from Bitcoin’s SHA-256, and why Litecoin fees are often just cents (or less). We also cover the Litecoin halving (August 2023), the 84 million max supply, and what all of that means for Litecoin tokenomics.

Then we get into the big twist: MWEB (MimbleWimble Extension Blocks), Litecoin’s optional privacy feature that can hide transaction amounts and improve fungibility… and why that sparked regulatory concerns and even exchange delistings in some regions. I also explain Litecoin’s relationship with Dogecoin merged mining, plus real-world usage like BitPay payments, wallets, buying LTC safely, and how people actually use Litecoin for fast transfers.
